observation_text: The old fisherman sat on the bench by the market. His fishing rod rested beside him. He set a brown pouch of gold coins on the ground beside the bench. A few coins caught the light near its opening. The river ran past the houses below the market. He took his time checking his fishing tackle. The wooden stall and the bench cast shadows across the path. Then the fisherman stood, picked up his rod, and walked toward the river. He left the pouch behind. Nobody called after him.
